title: Imbalances of Regional Pulmonary Ventilation in Patients With Post-acute-COVID-19
official: Imbalances of Regional Pulmonary Ventilation in Patients With Post-acute-COVID-19 Symptoms
summary: Investigation of the correlation of CT-morphological changes of the lung compared to regional ventilation distribution on electrical impedance tomography in patients with post-acute-Covid-19 symptoms.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all patients undergoing a Chest CT due to suspected post-acute-Covid-19-syndrome
* \>18 years
* informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* trauma patients and patients with unstable spinal injuries or fractures
* patients with an BMI over 50
* patients with uncontrolled body movements
* Patients with a pacemaker
